properties.site-address: Berwick Seaview Caravan Site, Billendean Road, Berwick-upon-Tweed
properties.notes: Potential longer-term opportunity for redevelopment of operational caravan park site. As this is currently occupied it would not be immediately available and an alternative site would have to be secured to enable relocation of the existing use before a proposal for housing could be progressed. Lower indicative yield reflects a range of constraints to the development of the site. Identified as an allocation in the draft Local Plan (submitted May 2019) .
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
